title: $A^p_α$ classes in the Dirichlet range: inner-outer factorization, Carleson measures and weak products
summary: We study properties of $A^p_α$ spaces in the Dirichlet range, recently defined by Brevig, Kulikov, Seip and Zlotnikov as the set of all holomorphic functions on the unit disc $\mathbb{D}$ such that \[ \int_{\mathbb{D}} |f(z)|^{p-2} |f'(z)|^2 (1 - |z|^2)^α \, dA(z) 0$. We answer in the negative two questions posed by Brevig et al. by showing that, if $p\ne2$ and $p > \frac{1}{2}$, $A^p_α$ is not a vector space and that the norm is in general not increasing in $p$. This is achieved by means of an equivalent description for $A^p_α$ which is given in terms of the Poisson integral of the boundary…
